description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
